title: Pharmacy Benefit Enrollment: One PrairieRx Plan per Member
content:
**Clause.** A member holds one Pharmacy Benefit plan at a time. A new pharmacy coverage is opened only when the member has no other coverage in pending, active or restricted status. A change of plan eligibility category ends the old pharmacy coverage the day before and opens the new one the same day.

The limit is 1 open pharmacy coverage per member.

### Basis of the check

- **What is checked:** the member's pharmacy coverage records, matched to the member for whom the new coverage would be opened.
- **Authority:** the system record of each coverage and its status. What the caller says about another coverage does not replace the record.
- **When:** before the new coverage is opened.
- **Which statuses bar a new coverage:** pending, active and restricted. A new coverage is a separate record; it is not opened while any coverage of the member stands in one of those statuses.

### Status table

| Status of an existing coverage of the member | Effect of this clause on opening a new pharmacy coverage |
|---|---|
| Pending | Not opened |
| Active | Not opened |
| Restricted | Not opened |
| Terminated | This clause does not bar the opening |

### Change of eligibility category

When the member's plan eligibility category changes, the two coverages meet without a gap or an overlap:

| Coverage | Date |
|---|---|
| Old pharmacy coverage | Ends on the day before the new coverage opens |
| New pharmacy coverage | Opens on the day of the change |

*Hypothetical example:* where the new pharmacy coverage opens on a given day, the old coverage's last day is the calendar day immediately before it, so that on any single day exactly one Pharmacy Benefit coverage is in force.
